title: Field path loop
ring: Nature S · the mountain-bike trail · {{KM}} km · from the front door · Poperinge ·
sub: Up the dreef, along Helleketelweg, home by the trail and the field.
desc: A short {{KM}} km loop from Kleine Dasdreef over Helleketelweg and the mountain-bike trail, Poperinge.

waypoints.name: Home
waypoints.title: Out of the door
waypoints.note: Down the gravel lane to Kleine Dasdreef, then left, up the dreef to Helleketelweg.
waypoints.accent: Clockwise: lanes first, the trail and the field on the way back.

waypoints.name: Helleketelweg
waypoints.title: Left onto Helleketelweg
waypoints.note: Follow it west for about a kilometre. Open fields, hop poles, hardly a car.

waypoints.name: Junction
waypoints.title: At the Karel Grimminckweg junction, left
waypoints.note: Where Karel Grimminckweg comes in from the right, leave the asphalt on the left and head south across the field edge to the start of the trail (a couple of hundred metres; not on the map).

waypoints.name: Onto the trail
waypoints.label: Onto the trail
waypoints.title: Onto the mountain-bike trail
waypoints.note: The unpaved trail runs south-east along the field edges, with the town's church towers on the horizon. Mountain bikers use it too, so keep an ear open.

waypoints.name: End of the trail
waypoints.label: End of the trail
waypoints.title: Across the field
waypoints.note: At the end of the trail, bear left across the field edge towards the gravel lane. This last link is not on any map; it is the way we walked it.
waypoints.accent: Confirm this bit on the next walk and I will fix the line if it runs differently.

waypoints.name: Back on the lane
waypoints.label: Back on the lane
waypoints.title: The gravel lane home
waypoints.note: Onto the far end of the gravel lane, and along it to the door.

goodtoknow: A short one: quiet lanes out, the unpaved mountain-bike trail and a field edge back. After rain the trail is muddy in the dips. Mountain bikers come through on weekends; step aside, they are usually quick to say thanks.

Two short links on this loop are drawn as straight dashed lines because they are not in OpenStreetMap: from the junction to the start of the trail, and from the end of the trail to the gravel lane. The rest of the line follows mapped paths. This page is a first draft of yesterday's walk; tell me where it differs and I will redraw it.
more: The trail is part of the Sport Vlaanderen mountain-bike network around Poperinge (the old Bloso routes), which stitches field edges and farm tracks into long unpaved loops. Walkers are welcome on them, and this one happens to pass almost behind the house.
tlcue: Clockwise. Distances are from the front door.
